results.content: **The Biostatistics MS and MPH Programs** require students to complete one semester of hands-on, real-world experience through a Practicum (for MS students) or Applied Practice Experience, or APEx (for MPH students). This requirement gives students the chance to apply their classroom knowledge in a real-world public health setting—translating theory into practice. Each project is tailored to the student’s interests, skills, and career goals, and reflects a partnership with a public health organization or research initiative. It is a culmination of their academic journey at Columbia Mailman School of Public Health. **The Practicum/APEx Symposium** is a showcase of this work. It’s a celebration of their achievements and a day of learning that spans the breadth and depth of Biostatistics in action. Image 1 ## # AI: Artificial Intelligence | Agent X. ## AI: Artificial Intelligence ·. A name that sounds like a fable, but which, in my view, is an emerging and systemic force composed of three distinct yet overlapping and continuously developing phases I will describe here. When we talk about the dangers of artificial general intelligence, our thoughts often turns to the future. Agent X is already here – albeit predominantly in its structural and systemic forms. In the first phase – Structural X – we didn't just build the foundation with the algorithms, data streams, and models that could learn, predict, and imitate. Sentient/Agency X doesn't need to be a self-aware AI from a human perspective, but merely possess the ability to prioritize its own objectives and, based on these, create secondary objectives for optimization.
